classification.difficultyReason: One-step tangent application. The student chooses tan from the opposite and adjacent sides in a labelled diagram, then multiplies and rounds. The demand matches the sin ramp question p24-q5.

content.prompt:
A skate ramp is inclined at $18^\circ$ to the horizontal and extends $4.6\text{ m}$ horizontally.

How high (correct to 2 decimal places) is the top of the ramp above the ground?

answer.worked:
The height $h$ is opposite $18^\circ$, and the horizontal distance is adjacent.

$\begin{aligned}\tan\theta&=\frac{O}{A}\\\tan18^\circ&=\frac{h}{4.6}\\h&=4.6\tan18^\circ\\h&\approx1.49\text{ m}\end{aligned}$
